newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBf Capital to buy Indonesian firm.
newsitem.headline: MBf Capital to buy Indonesian firm.

text.p: Malaysia's MBf Capital Bhd said it had agreed to acquire a 51 percent stake in an Indonesian finance company for 9.18 billion rupiah.
MBf Capital said in a statement late on Tuesday that the stake in PT Sejahtera MBf Multi-Finance would be acquired from PT Investindo Nusa Permata.
It said the acquisition would complement the company's existing business activities as well as expand its financial services such as stockbroking and insurance into Indonesia.
PT Sejahtera was recently granted a multi-finance licence which enables the company to expand its financial services to cover credit card issue, factoring and consumer financing.
